description: This Java source file defines an immutable class ImmutablePropertyFilter that implements the PropertySearchFilter interface. It provides factory methods to create instances with specific property paths, types, and values for filtering properties in a search context within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutablePropertyFilter
classes.description: An immutable implementation of PropertySearchFilter, representing criteria to filter properties based on type, path, and values.

methods.description: Static factory method to create an ImmutablePropertyFilter with type, property path, and a collection of filter values.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an ImmutablePropertyFilter with type, property path, a mandatory filter value, and optional additional values.

methods.description: Returns the property path in the filter.

methods.description: Returns the collection of filter values.
